name: khatt-pixabay
description: Khatt picture middleman: keeps Pixabay/Unsplash/Pexels API keys off the public website

PIXABAY_KEY.description: Your Pixabay API key. Log in at pixabay.com, open pixabay.com/api/docs and copy the key shown next to “key”.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: The website allowed to use this middleman (your Khatt app address).
